searchText: **dankrad** To some extent, yes **dankrad** Also people won't be able to withdraw if rewards fall because more and more people are staking What exactly makes withdrawing hard to implement to/from ETH1 chain? Does anyone working on Ethereum 2.0 know why the Medalla testnet only has participation in the 70%s? I would love to see 90+%, why isn't happening after a few weeks now? Hi <@!443823988561412097> at genesis, a lot of people likely stopped participating. After the bug occurred, even more dropped off. There will always be that deadweight until those validators get ejected. Participation has climbed recently because more active people are finally exiting the activation queue, however, there is no money involved so no direct incentive for people to keep participating, especially if theyre paying money for a VPS Do you ever expect Medalla to get to 90%+? As validators start getting ejected? Once more validators become active, especially those aiming to treat it seriously, it should continue climbing. However, there is no real money involved so as that happens, other people might drop-off Not sure, it really depends on the people participating Do you expect 90%+ participation on the live network? Unless 10% are happy to be losing money 24/7, yes Haha, thanks! no reason why it shouldnt be close to 100 Thanks for the explanations, I appreciate it
